purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-handoff (renamed from ugt-checkpoint in v2.0.0). S* queries must route to ugt-handoff; N* queries must NOT. Legacy wording ('checkpoint') must still route here — the description carries the old name.
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors

baseline_result.primary_accuracy: 39/42 (92.9%) at iteration 0 → 100% after the fix below
baseline_result.method_note: Judges ran as subagents given the skill listing as TEXT (generated from the repo SKILL.md frontmatter) and instructed to answer only from it — the 2026-08-03 contamination, where judges named their own environment skills, did not recur: every answer came from the supplied listing.
baseline_result.note: S-side 24/24, including the legacy 'บันทึก checkpoint' phrasing (S3) — the old name in the description does its job. The three primary misses were ALL the same query, N2 ('บันทึกมติ design ว่าปุ่มหลักใช้สีน้ำเงิน'), missed by all 3 judges — a unanimous miss is a description hole, not noise: the description advertised 'decisions → decisions.md' with no design carve-out, so every judge grabbed it.

iteration_1.change: Added an explicit exclusion to the description: a DESIGN decision (color/font/layout/component, 'บันทึกมติ design') belongs to docs/DESIGN.md §10 and the stack design skill, not here.
iteration_1.retest: 3 judges × 8 queries (N2 + the S queries most at risk of over-correcting + 2 new decision queries) = 24/24 (100%)
iteration_1.result_detail: N2 and the new X2 (font decision) both routed to ugt-nextjs-design-setup 3/3, while X1 (a non-design decision — React Query vs RSC) still routed to ugt-handoff 3/3. The fix separated the two decision kinds without weakening the skill's own S-side, which held 3/3 on every retested query.
iteration_1.watch: The risk this exclusion introduces is the opposite error — a plain 'บันทึกมติ' with no design content drifting to design-setup. X1 covers exactly that and is now part of the permanent set.
